name: Badge (count)
description: Number-in-a-circle indicator, shown standalone or overlaid on a child element (e.g. an icon); the system's only Badge variant besides a tonal 'empty' look.
notes: count text weight is semibold over --text-body-xs (--font-weight-semibold). Root minWidth is 18 (hug otherwise, growing with digit count); horizontal padding 5px is off the --space scale, kept as a raw number per source. When overlaid on a child (children prop set), root is absolutely positioned at top:-4/right:-4 with no ring/border around it — this system removed the ring present in earlier iterations. A `style` prop lets a consumer (e.g. Cart) nudge the overlay position per instance; not part of the default tree.
